scripts.db:reset: docker compose down && rm -rf .data/postgres && docker compose up -d db && npm run db:migrate && npm run seed
scripts.sync: docker compose exec api python -m app.sync --source all
scripts.sync:github: docker compose exec api python -m app.sync --source github
scripts.sync:dry: docker compose exec api python -m app.sync --source all --dry-run
scripts.insights: docker compose exec api python -m app.insights --period week --print
scripts.ticktick:auth: docker compose exec api python -m app.ticktick_auth
